notes.title: An update...
notes.content: I saw that this was listed as abandonware by a curator.  It is not.  It is very much in development but I have been waiting to announce or update till things are ready.  The updated project will be losing it's online component, because with no install base online games are not really online games so it's not worth the additional work.  However, it has become 4 time as large and is progressing towards my original vision.  My family and I have moved across the country twice and been in witness relocation for that last year.  One of those is not true.  I would not recommend buying it right now because I'm pretty sure I'll be releasing it for free when I update it.

notes.title: Update - Tag Team Back Again
notes.content:
Reintroduced the "plaunchers".

- On top of the dresser in the living room there is a new toy.  Grab the plunger looking things by grabbing them with the grips, not trigger.

-grab one of the balls next to them with the grip and place it on the end of the plauncher.

- fire with the trigger, repeat.

- you can also snap balls to your belt in order to carry them as you walk


Also introduced a few more achievements.

notes.title: Betacon
notes.content:
Hello 994ers.

We have just returned from Betacon Portland where we recieved 2nd Best Local Studio. Joys.  We demoed the game for a total of 20 hours to almost non stop lines on two different rigs. We have some specific areas we are going to focus on this week to address issues that reoccured.

- player spacial awareness and prevention of unexpected teleporting, particularly when using the blink teleportatin method.

- visual and audio feedback for all buttons and interactable items

- preventing users from accidentally teleporting while climbing

- setting armswinger as the default (this could change depending on y'alls feedback)

notes.title: Update 4/13
notes.content:
We will be taking 994 up to BetaCon in Portland, Oregon this weekend.  If you are in the area, stop on by.

- Players can now shoot other players with foam balls causing respawning. Effective during multiplayer phone charger game

- Yesterday an update corrected wall clipping, now you can slam your head through wall. yeah!!

-also disabled teleportation if controller is inside of a wall.  

-added additional coin collection spots only reachable by mad climbing skills
